title_as_printed: Densities and Apparent Molal Volumes of Aqueous KCl, NaF, Na2SO4, K2SO4, MgCl2, and MgSO4 Solutions at 0 and 50 C

footnotes_as_printed.a: Densities are in units of g/ml, and Phi_V is in units of ml/mol.

property_description: density of the solution minus density of pure water at the same T (Kell tabulation), g/ml, measured by magnetic-float densitometry; value = 1000 Delta_d x 1e-3. Apparent molal volume Phi_V is calculated by the authors and not used
pressure_note: not stated (atmospheric pressure implied by an open densitometer; paper gives no pressure)

value.what: Delta_d = d - d0, density of solution minus density of pure water at the same T (Kell tabulation); printed as 1000 Delta_d

composition.other_species: single salt per block, named in the label row (composition.salt set by group_rows); only the NaF blocks are outside the six-ion set and are kept

extra_unmapped: Phi_V ml/mol (apparent molal volume, calculated by the authors from the measured density difference)
conversion_needs: molality is mol per kg of water (paper: solutions made by weight)
notes: Page printed in four columns; blocks stacked in reading order: NaF 0C, Na2SO4 0C, MgCl2 0C (continues from column 1 into column 2 without a new label), KCl 50C, MgCl2 50C, MgSO4 50C, NaF 50C, K2SO4 0C, MgSO4 0C, Na2SO4 50C, K2SO4 50C. Column heading m is molality (units not printed in the heading; text says 'molal concentrations (m)'). Two values are printed with a subscript last digit and are written as one number: 0.57774(5) in KCl 50C -> 0.577745, 0.44699(8) in MgCl2 50C -> 0.446998. Replicate or near-replicate rows kept (e.g. 1.01833/1.01840 MgCl2 0C, 0.89006/0.89033 MgSO4 0C, 1.00476 twice Na2SO4 50C).
